about: Detail-oriented Virtual Assistant and Product Copywriter with over 6 years of experience in e-commerce operations, Shopify platform management, and product catalog optimization. I bridge the gap between suppliers and customers — sourcing winning products through market and trend research, writing SEO-driven product descriptions, and keeping inventory and sales reporting airtight. Having supported teams across the Netherlands, Singapore, and the Philippines, I bring cross-cultural adaptability, strong administrative coordination, and a sharp eye for what makes an online storefront convert.

experience.description: Managing end-to-end e-commerce operations for a Netherlands-based Shopify store, from supplier communication to sales reporting and product listing.
details: Prepare daily sales reports and update product stocks in the inventory management system
Communicate daily with Alibaba suppliers for order updates and tracking
Create weekly analytical reports including Data Analysis, Return Analysis, and Average Sales reports
Upload and optimize new product listings on Shopify with SEO-friendly descriptions
Manage product categorization and collection organization for better customer navigation

experience.description: Specialized in creating compelling product descriptions and optimizing listings for maximum visibility and conversion on the Shopify platform.
details: Created compelling product descriptions complete with images and customer reviews
Uploaded product descriptions, images, and reviews to the Shopify platform
Ensured product pages were complete and properly formatted before publishing online
Optimized product listings for search engines and customer conversion

experience.description: Delivered responsive customer support, ensuring high satisfaction across orders, shipping, and product inquiries.
details: Responded to customer inquiries regarding orders, products, and shipping
Handled order tracking and escalated customer complaints appropriately
Closely coordinated with the Team Leader on escalation results and resolutions
Maintained high customer satisfaction through timely and helpful communication

education.degree: Bachelor in Business Administration — Major in Management

projects.description: A personal site showcasing my professional profile, specializations, and an interactive online resume for prospective clients and employers.
